title: Cute. BUT. Stuck together
text: Cute. BUT. Stuck together. These are cute but I worried and it happened as other reviewers stated quite a few were very stuck together and ruined them even gently trying to separate. The few that remained I just used decoratively since there weren't enough to use as invitations. Cute idea -yes but quality control or packaging by manufacturing site is flawed

description: Get your tickets for the big event! a Yellow ticket pop-ups up reading "admit one" with four colorful balloons and has pre-printed lines ready for you to fill in all the details of your event. Each package contains 8 invitations. -By paper art

Ladies and gentleman, boy and girls, children of all ages, feast your eyes on these great Circus Time party supplies for your next little one's main event. Start by sending out these cute admission ticket style invitations. Admit tickets have fill in the blank information area on the front. Just write in party details, slip into circus themed decorated sleeve for a cute effect, stuff the included envelopes and send off. Party invitations measure 4 x 6-Inch. Includes 8 invites and 8 red envelopes. This retro-style theme features children's favorites under the big top including elephants on parade, lions wearing party hats and trained seals balancing balls on a fun striped vintage looking print. Creative Converting makes your celebration worth remembering. Come one, come all to the biggest event in town. Then, step right up for your matching dinner and dessert plates, lunch and beverage napkins, cups, new two-tone duo cutlery and plastic table covers. Don't forget to add to your vintage inspired birthday decor with coordinating cupcake displays, candy and punch bowls, favor bags, centerpieces, decorative banners, paper tissue lanterns, foil and glitter garlands, balloons and placemats from Creative Converting.
